blocks.html:
The computed values of a facet requested in a search query. Its shape depends
on the requested facet's type.

types.name: SearchFacetResult
types.description:
The computed values of a facet requested in a search query. Its shape depends
on the requested facet's type.

children.name: type
children.description: The facet counts per distinct value of the field.

children.name: values
children.description: The distinct values of the field and how many documents hold each of them.

children.name: other_count
children.description:
The number of documents falling outside the returned values, where the
provider reports it.

children.name: ranges
children.description: The requested ranges and how many documents fall in each of them.

children.name: key
children.description: The range's key, as passed in the request.

children.name: count
children.description: The number of documents in the range.

children.name: min
children.description: The field's smallest value among the matching documents.

children.name: max
children.description: The field's largest value among the matching documents.

children.name: avg
children.description: The average of the field's values, where the provider reports it.

children.name: sum
children.description: The sum of the field's values, where the provider reports it.

children.name: count
children.description: The number of documents the aggregations were computed over.
